entries.en: The builder replaced a damaged stanchion beneath the balcony.
entries.zh: 建筑工人更换了阳台下的一根受损支柱。

entries.en: The gymnast landed a handspring on the padded floor.
entries.zh: 体操运动员在铺有软垫的地板上完成了一次手翻。

entries.en: Persistent catarrh made the patient keep clearing her throat.
entries.zh: 持续的卡他让这位女患者不停地清嗓子。

entries.en: He mutely pointed to the broken window.
entries.zh: 他无言地指了指那扇破窗户。

entries.en: The photographs reveal the destructiveness of the coastal storm.
entries.zh: 这些照片揭示了沿海风暴的破坏性。

entries.en: The villain laughed maniacally as the laboratory lights flickered.
entries.zh: 实验室的灯光闪烁时，反派疯狂地大笑。

entries.en: The musician played a concertina outside the harbor cafe.
entries.zh: 音乐家在港口咖啡馆外演奏六角形手风琴。

entries.en: The cheerful boniface offered the travelers rooms above the dining hall.
entries.zh: 开朗的旅馆老板为旅客提供了餐厅楼上的客房。

entries.en: The workshop teaches basketry using willow gathered beside the river.
entries.zh: 这家作坊用河边采集的柳条教授篮子编织技艺。

entries.en: The singer shortened the unstressed syllable to fit the melody.
entries.zh: 歌手缩短了那个不重读的音节，以配合旋律。

entries.en: We had to hightail it when the angry bull approached.
entries.zh: 愤怒的公牛靠近时，我们不得不迅速逃走。

entries.en: The surgeon explained the tracheotomy to the patient's family.
entries.zh: 外科医生向患者家属解释了气管切开术。

entries.en: The persistent tapper at the window finally caught my attention.
entries.zh: 那个一直轻敲窗户的人终于引起了我的注意。

entries.en: The estimator inspected the roof before calculating repair costs.
entries.zh: 估价人员在计算维修费用前检查了屋顶。

entries.en: The lecture compared different traditions of eschatology and judgment.
entries.zh: 讲座比较了不同传统中的末世论与审判观念。

entries.en: A carved roundel decorated the center of the wooden door.
entries.zh: 一个雕刻的圆形饰物装饰着木门的中央。

entries.en: The university approved his readmission after a year away.
entries.zh: 他离校一年后，大学批准重新接纳他。

entries.en: We served the tortellini with a light tomato sauce.
entries.zh: 我们给意大利式饺子配上了清淡的番茄酱汁。

entries.en: The farrier checked the horse's hooves before fitting new shoes.
entries.zh: 蹄铁匠在钉新蹄铁前检查了马蹄。

entries.en: The two shapes are geometrically similar despite their different sizes.
entries.zh: 这两个图形虽然大小不同，但在几何学上相似。

entries.en: The lodged bone scratched the bird's gullet.
entries.zh: 卡住的骨头划伤了鸟的食道。

entries.en: The fraud led to the nullification of the contract.
entries.zh: 这起欺诈导致合同被取消。

entries.en: The baker brushed the brioche with egg before baking.
entries.zh: 面包师在烘烤前给奶油糕点刷上了蛋液。

entries.en: The courtier was ordered to kowtow before the throne.
entries.zh: 廷臣奉命在王座前叩头。

entries.en: A whelk clung to the rock beneath the shallow water.
entries.zh: 一只峨螺附在浅水下的岩石上。

entries.en: The union challenged ageism in the company's hiring practices.
entries.zh: 工会反对公司招聘中的年龄歧视。

entries.en: The training program aims to make its graduates more employable.
entries.zh: 这个培训项目旨在让毕业学员更有资格任职。

entries.en: She cut the vegetable and ham frittata into wedges.
entries.zh: 她把蔬菜火腿馅煎蛋饼切成了楔形块。

entries.en: My stepbrother moved in when his father married my mother.
entries.zh: 我继兄弟的父亲娶了我母亲后，他搬来与我们同住。

entries.en: The cattle waited in the stockyard beside the railway.
entries.zh: 牛群在铁路旁的牲畜围栏里等候。
